summary: Markdown wire fields carry x-st-text (markdown-block or markdown-inline) in the client-v0 schema, and the generated TypeScript client types them as opaque MarkdownBlock or MarkdownInline text; a guard rejects plain text spliced into Markdown templates unescaped

replay.detail: Web UI only; no replay or rebuild.

compatibility.detail: The wire and decoded values are unchanged strings. Forty client-v0 schema fields gain an x-st-text annotation; the generated TypeScript client now types them as branded MarkdownBlock or MarkdownInline, so TypeScript consumers read the words through markdownSource. Rust and Swift clients are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores plain string types; no stored data changes.
